name: bounce-sidebar
title: Bounce Sidebar
description: A vertical nav with a dot that hops along a curved path to the selected item.

props.name: items
props.description: The entries, top to bottom: { id, label, href?, icon?, disabled?, target?, rel? }.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Item selected first when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first item.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the item id whenever the selection changes.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the nav landmark.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the nav element.

props.name: indicatorClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the bouncing dot.
